newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere, Daewoo to take 17 bln Ffr Thomson debt.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere, Daewoo to take 17 bln Ffr Thomson debt.

text.p: The true cost of taking over Thomson SA will be 17 billion francs, split between Lagardere and Daewoo Electronics, financial daily Les Echos reported on Monday.
The paper said Daewoo would take on seven billion francs of Thomson debt, while Lagardere will take 10 billion of it.
The 17 billion francs corresponds to the total debts of Thomson after an 11 billion franc recapitalisation promised by the French government, Les Echos said.
Lagardere chairman Jean-Luc Lagardere has said the takeover would cost 26 billion francs overall.

But Les Echos said that figure included an 8 billion franc buyout of Thomson-CSF minority shareholders, which it said was unlikely to take place. The paper said at least some of those shareholders would probably hold on to those shares.
Lagardere plans to pay for the buyout of CSF minorities with some of its 12 billion francs of capital, the paper said.
